goal: Build consistent triathlon fitness while managing fatigue
notes: HR zones and VT1/VT2 come from a gas-analyser (lab) running test done about a year ago; the lab called them provisional.
The zones are for running. Cycling HR at the same effort usually runs 5-10 bpm lower, so treat bike HR caps as slightly conservative.
Do not recommend hard training when illness, unusual symptoms, or poor recovery are reported.
